Name: Golden Animal Cracker recipe from Mr. Qi
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Qi's Golden Animal Cracker Recipe is a lightweight Content Patcher mod that turns the vanilla Golden Animal Cracker into a cookable recipe reward from Mr. Qi.

The recipe is purchased from Mr. Qi's Walnut Room shop for 100 Qi Gems. Once learned, it appears in the cooking menu and the recipe listing disappears from the shop.

The cooking recipe makes 1 Golden Animal Cracker and requires:[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]5 Large Milk[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]5 Large Egg[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]5 Sugar[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]5 Wheat Flour[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]5 Gold Bars[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]5 Mystic Syrup[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Requirements[/b][/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Content Patcher 2.8.1 or later[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Tested on[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 build 26177[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.3.2.5[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Content Patcher 2.8.1[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Installation[/b][/font]
[list=1]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install Content Patcher.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility / Important notes[/b]
[list]
[*]The recipe uses the vanilla Golden Animal Cracker item; it does not add or replace the item itself.[/*]
[*]Only Android has been directly tested for this release.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*]ConcernedApe — Stardew Valley and the original Golden Animal Cracker item.[/*]
[*]Pathoschild — Content Patcher and SMAPI modding tools/documentation.[/*]
[/list]
